file_level_heuristics.description: All sheets are merged into this one JSON document; no worksheet is omitted.

extraction_notes: Every non-empty cell is preserved with its original Excel coordinate and value.
Detected tables and key-value pairs are structured interpretations; all_nonempty_rows/all_nonempty_cells remain the source-of-truth extraction.
Formula text and cached result are both retained where available. A cached result may be null if the workbook does not contain one.
Blank cells are not serialized individually; their positions remain inferable from coordinates and worksheet dimensions.
Heuristics are identification signals, not underwriting conclusions.
